# Claude Code Subagent Check

> Paste a Claude Code subagent definition and find why it never gets delegated to: bad name, vague description, wrong tools or model. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
